title: About | Sebastian Sanchez
description: Learn more about Sebastian Sanchez, a software engineer focused on backend systems, web applications, mobile products, and maintainable architecture.
ogDescription: Software engineer focused on scalable systems, clean architecture, and thoughtful product engineering.
heading: Building software with calm systems thinking.
intro: I'm Sebastian Sanchez, a software engineer based in Colombia. I work across backend, web, and mobile — focused on systems that are reliable, easy to evolve, and actually solve the problem.
bio: I started programming seriously around 2021, drawn to the idea that software can make things work better for real people. Since then I've built products across the full stack — from Spring Boot APIs and relational databases to React Native apps and Next.js frontends. I care about understanding the product context before writing a line, and I care even more about leaving the codebase in a better shape than I found it.

items.title: Backend systems
items.body: REST APIs, service architecture, database design. I like building things that scale gracefully and fail predictably.

items.title: Web development
items.body: From Next.js and Astro to plain TypeScript. I care about fast, accessible, and maintainable frontends.

items.title: Mobile
items.body: React Native for cross-platform products. I focus on the connection between mobile UX and the systems behind it.

items.title: Architecture
items.body: Clean separation, clear boundaries, honest tradeoffs. I try to make complexity manageable, not hidden.

items.title: Understand first
items.body: I want to know what the product needs to do before deciding how to build it.

items.title: Ship, then improve
items.body: Working software beats perfect plans. I'd rather put something real in front of users and iterate.

items.title: Keep it maintainable
items.body: Code is read far more than it's written. Clarity and consistency matter a lot to me.
